facts.label: After the story
facts.value: Free-roam continues; nothing needed for the platinum is locked out

facts_source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026

steps.body: Play the story through its 5 chapters and enjoy it. The 100% checklist is not visible until after the story, but any progress you make during it already counts. There are no mission gold medals, so you do not need to watch for hidden objectives. Do the optional missions as they appear, scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app, and study new animals with the binoculars. The one thing to watch: the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house for Positive Mental Attitude. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony, and choose Accept. Everything else can wait until after the story.
steps.title: Finish the story, and mind the one missable
steps.trophies: 12 story trophies, the side-character questlines, and the Chapter 1 meditation

steps.body: After the story the checklist unlocks under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. It is lenient, closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not needed, and you need any 70 of 80 challenges, any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied, and any 100 optional missions. The only tasks that need everything are Robberies, Underwater Discoveries, Shooting Ranges, Drone Races, and Bret's quests. Work the checklist in any order and most of the grind trophies pop along the way.
steps.title: The 100% Completion Checklist
steps.trophies: A Long Road, Cunning Stunts, The Shootist, Top Fun, One Last Thing, Maximum Withdrawal, Pest Control, and the collectibles

steps.body: Strangers & Freaks are not needed for 100%, so finish the 8 counting strands now, then sweep up whatever is left: the partner trophies, the combat and vehicle stunts, the money trophies, and the five trophies whose methods are still unknown. When the last one pops, the platinum follows.
steps.title: Strangers & Freaks and miscellaneous cleanup
steps.trophies: Strangers & Freaks, Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Gunslinger, Catch Me If You Can, Personal Best, and the unknowns

title: Roadmap to the platinum
warnings: Keep cheats off for the whole run: using one disables trophies and saving.
There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (10 saves), then rotate the remaining 5 for free-roam cleanup.

Optional missions with black icons and pink letters disappear after a while, and some quest givers go quiet for a chapter. Neither locks the platinum: every trophy-related quest giver is available again after the story, and there are far more than 100 optional missions.

Some fences become permanently unavailable and a few magazine collectibles sit in story buildings that later close. Neither matters for trophies: new fences unlock as you go, and the magazines also spawn elsewhere.
warnings_source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap, 18 Nov 2026
